description: AI Agents: Use as soon as someone wants an AI agent in one of their systems and the system is known. Pass only what they already said it should read, change or do; with the system alone it plans what every new agent starts with. Returns what the agent will do and one link that connects the system and saves the agent. Not for syncing two systems (use plan_integration).

action_groups.description: Optional groups of actions to switch on, as get_ai_agent_options names them.

change_record_types.description: Optional record types it may also change.

read_only.description: True only when the person said it may only read and never change anything.

read_record_types.description: Optional record types it may only read.

system.description: The system the agent works in. Its name or key, such as hubspot.

name: plan_ai_agent
title: Plan an AI agent
